source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Look here for the unit’s abilities that apply in play. A rule with several conditions may replace its first benefit with a stronger effect, or it may require the first condition as well as the extra one. Follow the stated relationship. For example, an ability can let ranged attacks against their nearest eligible target repeat hit results of one, then extend that permission to every hit result if that target also sits inside the range of an objective held by the opponent.
